title: Build Failure
description: rig's normalized record of a failed build or test step (the reject lane). Parsed and classified deterministically. The class decides routing before any model sees the failure: code and config go to the Builder; infra goes to a human; flaky gets one rerun; mechanical gets a deterministic auto-fix. An unrecognized failure is class unknown and is routed to a human (fail closed).

run_id.description: CI run that produced the failure.

fingerprint.description: Stable hash of the normalized errors; the same fingerprint seen again marks a recurring failure.

recurrence.description: Times this fingerprint was seen on this change before.

symbol.description: symbol_index entry the error localizes to, if found.

truncated.description: More errors existed than were kept.
